title: A common accessibility and compactness cardinal for a small family
statement: Use the universes $\mathcal U\in\mathcal U\prime$, smallness, accessibility and $\kappa$-compactness of [def-coef-presentable-infinity-category], and quasicategories and coherent mapping spaces of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Let $\mathcal C$ be an accessible infinity category. Let $J$ be a $\mathcal U$-small set and let $(X_j)_{j\in J}$ be a family of objects of $\mathcal C$. There exists an infinite regular cardinal $\kappa\in\mathcal U$ such that $\mathcal C$ is $\kappa$-accessible and every $X_j$ is $\kappa$-compact in $\mathcal C$.
